title: Oncology Targeted Therapy Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Tie targeted therapy recommendations to validated biomarkers, tumor type, and prior treatment exposure rather than biomarker presence alone.
Confirm line of therapy, performance status, and organ function before escalating to targeted regimens.
Document biomarker rationale and monitoring plan clearly when recommending targeted treatment.

title: Oncology Neutropenic Fever Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Treat neutropenic fever as a time-critical oncologic emergency with prompt broad-spectrum empiric coverage.
Risk-stratify for outpatient management only after hemodynamic stability, expected neutropenia course, and social safety are reviewed.
Escalate immediately when shock, pneumonia, line infection, or profound persistent neutropenia is suspected.

title: Oncology Survivorship Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Use a structured survivorship plan that covers recurrence surveillance, late toxicities, and preventive care.
Coordinate psychosocial, fertility, pain, and rehabilitation needs rather than limiting follow-up to recurrence checks alone.
Document ownership of follow-up tasks clearly between oncology and primary care.
